notes.title: New Ability: Hints
notes.content:
Hello dear adventurers!

We’ve heard your feedback, and we’re excited to introduce a new hint system to the game! This feature will help you find those waifus who’ve truly earned an S+ in hiding.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747108/0365083a014180ff19d0dc31d5946069dcf88938.png[/img]

You’ll unlock the hint ability after leaving the third room or beyond.

Additionally, we’ve implemented a new system that tracks fun stats for your individual save file, now viewable in the new stats menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747108/b0269d95e38cbfb2637348e9b58d872c5c7840d4.png[/img]

Here are some more notable changes in this update:
[list]
[*] Added background animation to the Leaderboards menu.
[*] Reduced the volume of Ursula's moans.
[*] Fixed the Edge Screen Panning settings option to work as intended.
[*] Screen dragging speed is now consistent across all levels.
[/list]

Thank you so much for supporting us, and we hope you enjoy this new update!

notes.title: Hotfix #1
notes.content:
Hello adventurers!

We're incredibly happy with the positive reception of the game and want to thank you all from the bottom of our hearts!

Today, we're releasing a small patch with some improvements:
[list]
[*] Fixed keys not triggering the clear screen if they were the last thing revealed.
[*] Adjusted the timing for some intimate animations.
[/list]

Have fun!

notes.title: More Waifu Variety: New Faces & Haircuts
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

The development of ToHW is going great! We've been busy exponentially increasing waifu variety in the rooms by creating a range of new faces and hairstyles for the waifus.

There are over 30 new faces and over 30 new hairstyles!
Below you have a glimpse at some of them:

[h3]4 of the new Hairstyles[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747108/f6dee9fad677fb4652a25e3406eb5b38c91ccb45.png[/img]

[h3]4 of the new Faces[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747108/ba1a42ba219b02c53c83fb27eb25a1c831b2986e.png[/img]

We hope you like them! If you're interested in seeing more, we have more content available on our Patreon, including info about the upcoming exclusive demo build.
https://www.patreon.com/MizukiSoftware


We'll keep at it, so expect more juicy updates soon.
Much love from Mizuki Software! <3
